_comment: USD per 1M tokens, from DeepSeek's published sheet (https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing). These are the PEAK rates on purpose: the spend cap and every estimate should never understate. Off-peak is about half (flash input 0.15 / output 0.60; pro input 0.66 / output 1.98). cachedInput is the cache-hit rate, which is what most of a run's prompt tokens land on: the world prefix is identical call to call. Legacy ids are priced too, since a request to one is served and billed as the current model.
